title: Recovering a finite graded module from the section tail of its associated sheaf
statement: Let $S=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}S_d$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring with $S_0$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], generated as an $S_0$-algebra by finitely many elements of $S_1$. Let $M=\bigoplus_{d\in\mathbf Z}M_d$ be a finitely generated graded $S$-module, meaning $S_aM_b\subseteq M_{a+b}$. Put $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj]. For $n\in\mathbf Z$, let $M(n)_d=M_{n+d}$ and let $\widetilde{M(n)}$ be the associated sheaf of the shifted module [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. The canonical $S_0$-linear map $M_n\longrightarrow H^0(X,\widetilde{M(n)})$ [pqf-def-cohomology], sending $x\in M_n=M(n)_0$ to the section with restriction $x/1$ on every standard homogeneous localization chart, is an isomorphism for all integers $n\ge n_0$, for some $n_0\ge0$. Neither nonemptiness of $X$ nor absence of irrelevant-ideal torsion in $M$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0AG7, lemma-recover-tail-graded-module; constructions.tex Tag 01MT, lemma-apply-modules, identifies the target with the sheaf associated to the shifted module because S is generated in degree one.

proof.text: Choose the finite degree-one generators $f_i$ from the hypothesis, and put $\mathcal F=\widetilde M$. Apply [lem-sfb-finite-graded-proj-section-comparison] to obtain a Noetherian ring $S$, a coherent $\mathcal F$, the graded module $N=\bigoplus_n\Gamma(X,\mathcal F(n))$, and the degree-preserving $S$-linear canonical map $\phi:M\to N$. It also gives that every $\phi_{(f_i)}$ is an isomorphism, including empty charts.

source.place: Tag 0AG7, lemma-recover-tail-graded-module, coherence and the sheafified unit/counit calculation (old steps 1--4).

proof.text: The hypotheses on $S_0$ and the degree-one generators, together with coherence of $\mathcal F$, let us apply [lem-sfb-standard-proj-coherent-section-finiteness]. Its graded action is the same multiplication-by-sections action used for $N$, so $N^+=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}N_n$ is finite over $S$.

source.place: Tag 0AG7, nonnegative section-module finiteness, using Tag 0AG6, lemma-coherent-on-proj(4).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-graded-local-isomorphism-tail] to $\psi=\phi$. Step 1 supplies Noetherianity, degree preservation and all the localized isomorphisms; $M$ is finite by hypothesis and $N^+$ is finite by step 2. The lemma gives a nonnegative bound $n_0$ for which $\phi_n:M_n\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal F(n))$ is an $S_0$-linear isomorphism for every $n\ge n_0$.

source.place: Tag 0AG7, nonnegative kernel/cokernel argument and final degree bound (old steps 5--8).

proof.text: For $n\ge n_0$, compose $\phi_n$ with $\Gamma(\alpha_{M,n})$, using [lem-sfb-standard-proj-twist-tensor]. This is an isomorphism to $H^0(X,\widetilde{M(n)})$. By the definition of $\phi_n$ in step 1 it is the canonical section map, whose restriction on every standard chart is $x\mapsto x/1$. This proves the statement, with the same bound for all integers $n\ge n_0$.

source.place: Tag 0AG7, conclusion; constructions.tex Tag 01MT, lemma-apply-modules (old step 9).

proof_origin.place: Tag 0AG7, lemma-recover-tail-graded-module; chartwise version of its kernel/cokernel proof, using 0AG5 and 0AG6(4).
